title: Fifth Marine Regiment Sets Up Command Post By Southern Tip of Chosin Reservoir in Latter Days of November
partOf: NARA › RG 127 › General Photograph File of the U.S. Marine Corps
summary: Original Caption: 1stMarDiv Hagaru-ri 21-25Nov50 Photog: Sgt. F.C. Kerr Fifth Marine Regiment sets up command post by southern tip of Chosin Reservoir in latter days of November. Amid wreckage of former homes, natives rummage for supplies for themselves and their farm animals.
